description: MSN keeps all four unit edges of a haplotype square
derivation: Hand-traced against AbstractMSN::computeMSN (strict, epsilon=0). Sequences AA, AT, GA, GT: unit-distance pairs are AA-AT, AA-GA, AT-GT, GA-GT; the two diagonals have distance 2. At level 1, all four pairs are cross-component with respect to the pre-level components (each vertex its own component), so all four edges are added before any merging; the graph is then connected (maxValue = 1 + 0) and level 2 breaks the sweep. Ids by sorted sequence: AA->H1, AT->H2, GA->H3, GT->H4.
